components.description: Accrued major medical leave of state employees (IHL Board Policy 803, administered under state statute), which pays a temporary disability absence, childbearing included, from the employee's own balance during the IHL 804 disability leave. Accrual rates are set by statute and are not in the saved documents.
components.mechanism_note: An accrued balance administered 'in accordance with state statute'; no childbirth-specific period or length is stated, so V1 does not make it a childbirth benefit; pay from the employee's own balance (R1, R1b).
components.faculty_group_note: IHL 803 applies to institutional employees; the Faculty Handbook refers to faculty absences on 'earned major medical leave', and IHL 804.03 speaks of nine-month faculty with 'accrued personal and major medical leave'.
components.eligible_parent_wording: temporary sickness or disability; 'Leave necessary for the purpose of childbearing is included in this policy' (IHL 804.01)
components.entitlement_note: The balance is the employee's accrued leave, administered 'in accordance with state statute'; no approval language governs its use for a covered disability. Its use for childbearing comes through IHL 804, whose leave status is discretionary (c3).

sequence.note: IHL 804 covers 'leave with or without pay' for a temporary disability; the accrued balance pays the disability absence, and the unpaid leave 'accompanies' it. The text does not fix the order; the balance is placed at the start of the disability leave. A balance of unknown length adds no weeks.

It contains no parental, maternity, family or medical leave provision of its own; it refers to leaves to which employees are entitled 'under the terms of contracted employment, i.e., annual leave, medical leave' (6.2.1) and to the USM Employee Handbook for benefits. Coded from it: tenure deferral 9.6.6 (c5). Academic leaves (6.2) are for professional development only.

Its personnel leave policies are coded: 802 personal leave (c2; nine-month faculty excluded), 803 major medical leave (c1), 804 disability leave incl. childbearing (c3), 805.06 leave without pay (c4). No FMLA, maternity, paternity, parental or adoption provision appears in any saved source.
